features.name: SAF-T (Standard Audit File - Tax) Export
features.description: Export functionality for SAF-T format based on the audit file export standard. Available as a pre-installed feature in Danish environments with support for exporting bookkeeping data in DK format with additional fields including master data, general ledger entries, and source documents.
caveats: Cloud solution only for DBA certification; on-premises requires separate certification
SAF-T data must include mappings for chart of accounts and VAT posting setup
Parallel processing required for large exports with many entries

features.name: Public Standard Chart of Accounts
features.description: Provides a standard chart of accounts for Denmark that users can map their own chart of accounts against. Includes automatic matching capability and manual mapping options for GL accounts.
caveats: All accounts in chart of accounts must be mapped to standard accounts
Matching is not automatic for all accounts; 57 of 18600 accounts matched automatically in demo

features.name: Public Standard VAT Chart of Accounts
features.description: Standard VAT chart of accounts for Denmark with mapping capability to sales VAT reporting or purchase VAT reporting codes for SAF-T export.
caveats: VAT posting setup mapping is optional
Requires specification of VAT code for sales or purchase reporting

features.name: Regas Basis Export to CSV
features.description: Export functionality to export bookkeeping data to Regas Basis as a CSV file. Designed for performance optimization with support for active session export or later export for large datasets.
caveats: CSV format used for performance optimization
Can handle export of large datasets

features.name: SAF-T File Import
features.description: Capability to import SAF-T files to keep history of audit data using the same audit file export functionality.
caveats: Import functionality provided to maintain historical records

features.name: Mandatory Digital Vouchers as Attachments
features.description: Requirement to attach digital vouchers as part of the bookkeeping compliance for the Danish Bookkeeping Act. Sales invoices support automatic document generation at post time; purchase documents require manual attachment. Enforcement begins July 1st for sales and purchase documents.
caveats: Mandatory requirement per DBA regulations
Voluntary until July 1st, then enforced for sales and purchase documents
Manual attachment required for purchase documents
Automatic generation only for sales invoices
Setup controlled by source codes for journals

features.name: 5-Year Data Retention Compliance
features.description: Capability to keep bookkeeping data for 5 years as required by Danish Bookkeeping Act regulations. Transactions and digital vouchers are retained for a minimum of five years after the end of the financial year.
caveats: 5-year retention is a legal requirement
Any customization affecting data retention impacts standard solution status
Data older than five years is automatically removed

features.name: SAF-T Dimensions Export
features.description: Capability to export dimensions to SAF-T with automatic assignment of specific analysis type code for each dimension. Users can configure which dimensions to include in export.
caveats: Dimensions export is optional; can be disabled per dimension

features.name: SAF-T Setup Guide
features.description: Feature management enabled setup guide for SAF-T configuration with step-by-step process for defining standard account type, reporting period, chart of accounts mapping, VAT posting setup, dimensions, and employee information.
caveats: Feature must be enabled in feature management
Enabling in one company enables for all companies

features.name: RB Accounting File Generation
features.description: Generation of accounting files in CSV format containing account names and balances. Supports net change or balance at date calculation methods for income statement and balance accounts.
caveats: Calculation method selection required

features.name: VAT Submission via Tax API
features.description: Electronic VAT submission to Danish tax authority through tax API to SKAT. Feature is pre-installed by default on cloud and on-premises, but uses different certificate approaches.
caveats: On-premises solutions require customer certificate from SKAT
Microsoft certificate pre-installed only for cloud solutions
Documentation still being updated

features.name: NemHandle Notification and Registration
features.description: Automatic notification requiring CVR number registration with NemHandle when creating a company. Notification appears in cloud and on-premises; can be disabled in sandbox but not production.
caveats: Not a technical blocker but mandatory for invoicing in future
Cannot be disabled in production environment
Registration instruction provided in notification

features.name: E-Document Invoicing Framework
features.description: E-document invoicing based on global e-document framework supporting UBL and Peppol formats. Enables both delivery and receipt of invoices with support for messaging, approval, rejection, and status logging.
caveats: Only one default service currently enabled
Requires certified access points for NemHandle connection
Additional services planned but not yet available
Direct connection with NemHandle not supported without certification

features.name: Digital Voucher Attachment for Purchase Invoices
features.description: Users can attach digital vouchers to purchase invoices in an incoming document files box. Posting is blocked without an attached digital voucher and shows an error message.
caveats: Purchase invoices require digital voucher attachment to post

features.name: Digital Voucher Generation for Sales Invoices
features.description: Sales invoices automatically generate and attach digital vouchers when posted, without requiring manual attachment like purchase invoices do. The generated invoice is attached as a digital voucher.
caveats: Sales invoices generate vouchers automatically unlike purchase invoices

features.name: Incoming Document File Attachment to Ledger Entries
features.description: Incoming document files attached to posted transactions are also associated with all related general ledger entries, maintaining a single attachment reference across all entries.

features.name: Attachment Immutability After Posting
features.description: Once a document is posted with an attachment, the original attachment cannot be removed or updated, but additional attachments can be added to the posted document.
caveats: Only original attachment is immutable; additional attachments can be added

features.name: Automated Transaction Export to Secure Storage
features.description: Business Central automatically exports transaction data and digital vouchers on a daily basis to secure blob storage. The data cannot be changed, deleted, or accessed by users.
caveats: Cloud only - does not exist in on-premises solution
Users have no access to exported data

features.name: CVR Number Requirement for Transaction Posting
features.description: Users must enter their CVR number (Danish company registration number) in company information to post general ledger transactions. The system blocks all GL transactions if CVR number is not entered.
caveats: Required only for companies with transactions
Not required for master data only companies
Applies only to production environment

features.name: Minimal Required Fields Export for Compliance
features.description: Only minimal sets of fields required by DBA regulations are exported from tables including GL entries, customer ledger entries, sales and purchase documents, and master data. Additional fields remain inaccessible.
caveats: Only DBA-authorized agencies can request this data with legal power

features.name: Sandbox Environment Exemption from CVR Requirement
features.description: Sandbox environments do not require CVR number entry and can be used freely for testing without any blocking or notification. CVR number restrictions apply only to production environments.
caveats: Restrictions apply only to production environment

features.name: CVR Number Persistence in Production Copies
features.description: When copying a production company to a new company, the CVR number is not copied, allowing the new company to be deleted or modified without restrictions until a new CVR number is entered.
caveats: CVR number must be re-entered for new company to apply restrictions

features.name: Production Company Immutability and CVR Blocking
features.description: Production companies with a CVR number cannot be deleted. Once CVR number is entered, it cannot be removed from the production company.
caveats: Cannot delete production company once CVR number is entered

features.name: Name Handle Registration Notification and Posting Blocks
features.description: Users not registered with name handle receive a notification (non-blocking). Users without CVR number are blocked from posting to general ledger. Entering CVR number unblocks posting but name handle notification persists until registration is complete.
caveats: Name handle notification is informational only; CVR number enforces posting block
